title: Live Nation Adds Venue on Australia’s Gold Coast
summary: Surfers Music Hall will be a 2,500-capacity live music space in Surfers Paradise, with a target to open its doors in mid-2028.
body: GOLD COAST, Australia — Live Nation continues to expand its venues portfolio in Australia, adding a new facility on the Gold Coast. Announced this week, Surfers Music Hall will be a 2,500-capacity live music space in Surfers Paradise, the hometown of chart-topping pop star Amy Shark , with a target to open its doors in mid-2028. Surfers Music Hall will be the concerts giant’s first venue on the Gold Coast, and the first dedicated live music venue of this scale in the region. When complete, the space will bring more national and international tours to the Gold Coast, the second biggest city in Queensland, “while giving local artists a new stage,” reads a statement. Bookings will be open “to a range of promoters,” the message continues. The timing of the new venue is critical. Queensland’s music and entertainment communities are preparing for the opportunity of a lifetime, when Brisbane hosts the 2032 Summer Olympic Games and Paralympic Games. The Gold Coast, about 50 miles south of Brisbane, won’t miss out. Hockey, triathlon, marathon swimming, and basketball games are earmarked for the city. title: The Galaxy S26 Ultra and Z Fold 8 Ultra get 24K gold editions for Christmas
summary: Samsung's Ultra flagships are getting the Midas touch.
body: TL;DR Goldgenie has launched customized Galaxy S26 Ultra and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra editions in 24K gold, rose gold, and platinum finishes. Prices start at £2,597 (~$3,400) for the S26 Ultra and £4,395 (~$5,757) for the Z Fold 8 Ultra. Both phones come with free worldwide shipping and a lifetime warranty on the customization. For most people, choosing a new smartphone color comes down to whatever the manufacturer offers. But for those with deeper pockets, even Samsung’s most expensive phones have room for a little more luxury. Goldgenie has been turning Galaxy flagships into shiny status symbols since the days of the Galaxy S6 , and more than a decade later, the company is giving the Galaxy S26 Ultra and Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra a 24K gold makeover, just in time for Christmas. Goldgenie has opened orders for customized versions of Samsung’s two flagships in three finishes: 24K gold, rose gold, and platinum. The latter uses rhodium, a precious metal in the platinum group. All three finishes feature a highly reflective, mirror-like appearance.
